mcqs.question: The proposed Chelam Hill thermal power project in Srikakulam involves which of the following combinations?
options: ₹30,000 crore, approximately 1,200 acres, with technology from L&T and BHEL
₹30,000 crore, approximately 3,200 acres, with technology from L&T and BHEL
₹3,200 crore, approximately 1,200 acres, with technology from L&T and BHEL
₹30,000 crore, approximately 1,200 acres, with technology from CESL and BHEL
mcqs.explanation: The Chelam Hill project is estimated to cost ₹30,000 crore, require approximately 1,200 acres and use technology from L&T and BHEL. The tempting second option is incorrect because the land requirement is approximately 1,200 acres, not 3,200 acres.

mcqs.question: In the Andhra Pradesh Group of Ministers formed to oversee and regulate social media platforms, which portfolio is held by Kolusu Parthasarathy?
mcqs.explanation: Kolusu Parthasarathy holds the Housing and I&PR portfolio in the Group of Ministers. IT and HRD is associated with Nara Lokesh, making it the most likely trap.
